name: read-only Lambda access does not fire LAMBDA-CODE-OVERWRITE
note: Stage-13 EFO-3 negative: lambda:GetFunction / lambda:ListFunctions cannot change a function's code, so the standalone code-overwrite primitive must NOT fire. Only lambda:UpdateFunctionCode (or a grant that includes it) is the overwrite capability.
rationale: lambda:GetFunction and lambda:ListFunctions are read/list actions; they do not modify function code and therefore cannot run attacker-supplied code under the function's execution role. LAMBDA-CODE-OVERWRITE must fire only on lambda:UpdateFunctionCode (the code-replacement action), so a read-only Lambda policy is a true negative for both the standalone code-overwrite primitive and the PassRole-Lambda path.
